value.rationale: The arbitrary leaf-placement family interpolates between bare cycles, single-leaf lollipops and full sunlets while computing every connected forcing-set coefficient. It detects configurations not determined by the degree sequence: n=7 and three leaves yields two full coefficient lists with different minimal powers. Complete size distributions and a verifiable local reachability rule are naturally useful for nonuniform connected deployment choices.
